children: Tunisia signed loan agreements with the African Development Bank on Tuesday worth $237 million to finance projects involving two state-owned companies, aimed at improving water services and upgrading industrial infrastructure.
The first loan, worth €111.5 million ($127 million), will finance improvements to the technical and energy efficiency of the drinking-water network in Tunis.
A second $110 million loan will support the environmental upgrading and modernization of production units at Tunisia’s state-owned Chemical Group.
